stories.headline_en: Israeli Forces Launch Rare Central Gaza Ground Offensive Beyond Yellow Line
stories.summary_en: Israeli ground forces and tanks have advanced into central Gaza west of the designated Yellow Line near Nuseirat refugee camp and Salah al-Din road. The Israeli military stated the operation targeted a tunnel threatening its forces, while Hamas condemned the move as a flagrant violation of their ceasefire agreement.
stories.why_en: The advance represents the first major ground offensive announced by Israel since the October 2025 ceasefire, escalating fears of renewed widespread displacement across Gaza.

sources.title: Israeli military launches rare ground operation in Gaza beyond Yellow Line
What does Israel’s new ground offensive mean for Palestinians in Gaza?

stories.headline_en: US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth Announces Military Cooperation Pact in Venezuela
stories.summary_en: United States Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth conducted a surprise visit to Caracas to meet Venezuela's interim President Delcy Rodriguez. The two governments announced a new bilateral military agreement focusing on intelligence sharing, joint training, and regional security cooperation.
stories.why_en: The pact formalises a swift security alignment between Washington and Caracas following the US operation that removed former President Nicolas Maduro earlier this year.

sources.title: US Defence Secretary Hegseth reveals military partnership on Venezuela trip
Hegseth uses Venezuela visit to boast of Maduro’s capture by US military

stories.headline_en: Trump Greeted by Xi and Putin Ahead of Landmark Talks in China
stories.summary_en: US President Donald Trump arrived in Shenzhen for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum, where he was welcomed by Chinese President Xi Jinping and met Russian President Vladimir Putin. The three leaders are scheduled to hold their first joint in-person trilateral summit.
stories.why_en: The summit marks the first face-to-face gathering of the US, Chinese, and Russian heads of state to address critical global security tensions, trade, and international conflicts.

sources.title: Trump shakes hands with Putin and Xi ahead of historic talks in China

stories.headline_en: Anthropic Prepares US Market Flotation Valuing AI Firm Over One Trillion
stories.summary_en: Artificial intelligence developer Anthropic is listing shares on the US stock market at an expected range of $70 to $78 per share, establishing an overall valuation surpassing $1 trillion. The move will substantially boost the paper wealth of its seven co-founders, who launched the firm in 2021.
stories.why_en: The milestone initial public offering underscores the rapid financial growth and dominance of frontier generative AI providers in global capital markets.

sources.title: The seven Anthropic founders who are about to become multi-billionaires

stories.headline_en: Grand Theft Auto 6 Receives Record-Tying Critical Acclaim Following Long Wait
stories.summary_en: The long-awaited release of Grand Theft Auto 6 has garnered overwhelmingly positive reviews, earning a 99 out of 100 aggregate score on Metacritic to tie an industry record standing since 1998. Reviewers highlighted the title's detailed world-building, technical fidelity, and character depth.
stories.why_en: After 13 years in development, the game's release stands as one of the most prominent entertainment and tech product rollouts of the decade.

sources.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 is a masterpiece, say critics
